prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Task: 将图1角色按图2、图3的项目宝石 icon 画风重绘，输出一张完整全身角色单体审阅稿。这里的“宝石icon画风”明确指项目的粗墨线、简化手绘卡通、大色块与低光泽画法。她仍然是穿衣服的人物，不是水晶雕像、珠宝头像或宝石材质人物。

Input roles:
Image 1 = ONLY character identity, original costume, color design, butterfly sleeves and open-arm gesture reference. This is the character to redraw.
Images 2 and 3 = PRIMARY and authoritative drawing-style references: chunky graphic silhouette, strong dark natural ink outline, broad angular painted light/shadow shapes, a few visible large dry-brush strokes, matte restrained color. Match this visual vocabulary.
Image 4 = supporting example of how this same project translates its gem-icon art into a FULL-BODY human cartoon character: stout readable stylized anatomy, simplified face/eyes, strong silhouette, compact proportions and broad painted clothing planes. Copy neither the archer's clothes, weapon, hair, brown palette nor male identity.

Draw ONE female character from head to feet. Preserve the distinctive very long silver-white hair, two tall black-purple upward curved horns, pointed elf ears, violet eyes, small forehead ornament, original dark violet and black outfit with restrained gold edging and white front fabric panel, large violet-blue butterfly-shaped sleeves, long dark boots and flowing broad hair/tail shapes. Keep the welcoming confident slight smile and open-arm gesture from image 1, simplified into a clear balanced full-body pose. Clearly recognizable as that exact original character. Use compact stylized proportions around 4 heads tall with a readable larger head, elegant yet solid limbs, and both hands and both feet anatomically clear and fully visible. A subtle three-quarter turn toward viewer's left is suitable, with the expressive face readable.

Rendering: strong deep ink-purple outer contours with organic line weight, mostly flat matte gouache/ink-cartoon painting. Reduce each major material to approximately 3–5 LARGE value/color shapes. Group silver hair into a few broad locks; wing sleeves into broad deep violet shapes and only 2–3 simplified lavender/cyan butterfly markings per side. Merge micro jewelry, threads, chains and embroidery into a few bold gold shapes retaining original costume placement. Use confident graphic contour rhythms and a small number of broad hand-painted strokes. Face uses simple cartoon eye shapes and flat violet pupils/irises with at most one small highlight each; no realistic multi-ring jewel eyes, no detailed eyelashes. The warm pale face is simple and readable, expression slightly playful. Palette stays silver-white, ink-violet, lavender, muted blue/cyan butterfly accents and modest dull gold.

Critical: preserve PERSON identity, not a literal gemstone transformation. No crystalline skin/hair/clothing, no sparkling jewel facets scattered across the body, no glossy anime rendering, no photorealistic material, no refraction, no gradients of shiny rainbow lighting. No dense polygon mosaic, no tiny broken facets, no excessive fine strands, no new accessories. No bow, quiver or archer costume from image 4. No halo, circular ornament, icon frame, badge, portrait crop, scenery, text, watermark, or multiple characters. Omit detached sparkle decorations and accessory rings to keep the silhouette clear.

Composition: square canvas, one COMPLETE full-body figure, overall height approximately 88 percent of canvas with clean safe margins around horn tips, sleeves, hair and boot soles. All original identifying costume masses visible. Flat uniform warm off-white background as an offline review image, no checkerboard, no paper texture and no ground shadow.
purpose: Project gem-icon drawing-style full-body character review; opaque warm off-white background.
visual_review: Recognizable horns, silver hair, violet butterfly sleeves, original open-arm gesture and dark gold-trimmed outfit retained; full body and both feet visible; broad matte painted shapes and dark outlines. No runtime integration.
